You should arrive on the island three business days before your wedding to complete the necessary paperwork. The couple must provide valid passports, birth certificates, and proof of marital status (single or divorced). There's no residency period required, and the marriage license can be obtained on the island with relative ease. Please speak with your Certified Destination Wedding Specialist for more information. Celebrate your love in the stunning island paradise of St. Thomas, the heart of the U.S. Virgin Islands. With its breathtaking beaches, crystal-clear waters, and luxurious resorts, St. Thomas is a top choice for a dream destination wedding. Whether you envision a romantic beachfront ceremony, an elegant affair at a luxury resort, or a charming garden wedding, St. Thomas offers endless possibilities. Easily accessible with direct flights from the U.S., it's a convenient yet exotic destination for you and your guests. Plus, the island's vibrant culture, world-class dining, and exciting activities ensure a memorable experience beyond the wedding day. With expert planners and all-inclusive packages, a St. Thomas wedding is seamless and stress-free. Explore our St. Thomas Destination Wedding Guide for expert tips and everything you need to plan your perfect wedding in paradise! Escape to the beauty of St. Croix, a breathtaking Caribbean paradise perfect for your dream wedding. From pristine beaches and lush gardens to historic estates, St. Croix offers a variety of stunning backdrops for your special day. Whether you envision an intimate beachfront ceremony, a charming garden wedding, or a grand celebration, St. Croix weddings provide endless possibilities. Located in the heart of the U.S. Virgin Islands, St. Croix is easy to reach with direct flights from the mainland U.S. Guests can explore the island's vibrant culture, enjoy world-class snorkeling, or relax in the island's serene atmosphere before and after your big day. With expert wedding planners and all-inclusive packages available, your St. Croix wedding will be effortless and unforgettable. Start planning today and make your dream wedding in St. Croix a reality! Say "I do" in the serene paradise of St. John, the most secluded and breathtaking island in the U.S. Virgin Islands. With its pristine beaches, lush national parks, and crystal-clear waters, St. John offers the perfect romantic setting for an intimate wedding celebration. Whether you dream of a barefoot ceremony on Trunk Bay's white sands, a scenic vow exchange overlooking the turquoise Caribbean, or a private villa wedding surrounded by nature, St. John provides a truly magical experience. With no airport on the island, guests arrive by ferry from St. Thomas, adding to the charm and exclusivity of a St. John wedding . From expert local planners to luxurious resorts, your wedding in St. John can be as relaxed or as elegant as you desire. Start planning your unforgettable day in this unspoiled island paradise!
